title: Anisotropic Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg inequalities for the Minkowski functional: $L^p$-remainder identities and extremals
summary: We establish exact anisotropic $L^p$-Hardy and Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg identities associated with the Minkowski functional $\|\cdot\|_K$ and the anisotropic radial derivative $\mathcal R_K$, where $1<p<\infty$ and $K\subset\RN$ is a smooth and strictly convex body containing the origin in its interior, not necessarily origin-symmetric. These identities contain explicit nonnegative $R_p$-remainders and yield sharp anisotropic radial $L^p$-Hardy and $L^p$-Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg inequalities.
